summary: Dashboard shows OCCUPIED for a room that has not sent any reading
found_by: Exploratory testing of the dashboard; reproduced by TC_UI_01 in run1-initial
description: A room with no readings in the database is shown with the green OCCUPIED badge, so the operator cannot tell an occupied room from a room whose sensor node is offline.
steps: Start the server with a new database: python -m app.server --db data/new.db
Select room CR-201 (no reading has been posted for it)
resolution: Fixed - RoomMonitor.status() now reports NO_DATA until the first frame is received; the dashboard shows the NO DATA badge (app/engine.py).

summary: False AC_ON_VACANT alert when the mean temperature drop is just below the threshold
description: The mean drop was rounded to 2 decimals before being compared with delta_t_threshold, so a drop of 0.499 deg C became 0.50 and the AC was reported ON in a room where it is off.
steps: Send 2 occupied frames, then 5 empty frames with all regions at 25.0 deg C
60 s after vacancy is confirmed, send an empty frame with all regions at 24.501 deg C
resolution: Fixed - the comparison uses the unrounded mean (rounded to 6 decimals only to remove floating-point noise); 2-3 decimal rounding is kept only for display (app/engine.py).
retest: TC_M1_19, TC_M1_20, TC_M1_21, TC_M1_22 PASS in run2-retest

summary: API returns 404 'Room None not found.' when room_id is missing
description: A reading posted without room_id is treated as a lookup of a room called None. The status code and message hide the real problem from the sensor-node developer.
steps: POST /api/readings with a valid frame body that has no room_id field
resolution: Fixed - a missing or empty room_id is rejected with 400 'room_id is required.' before the room lookup (app/server.py).
retest: TC_M2_04 PASS, TC_M2_03 still PASS in run2-retest

summary: Settings validation messages on the dashboard show internal field names
description: The settings form displays the API message as it is, e.g. 'vacancy_frames must be between 1 and 300.', instead of the label the operator sees on the form.
steps: In Detection settings enter Empty frames = 301, Wait = 60, Threshold = 0.5
expected: Empty frames to confirm vacancy must be between 1 and 300. (FR-2.7)
resolution: Fixed - the dashboard replaces the API field name with the form label before showing the message (app/static/app.js).
